body.normal: Subscribers are the first shareholders. They sign the MOA and AOA at incorporation and agree to take a set number of shares. A subscriber can be a person or a company, such as your parent company.
body.simple: Subscribers are the first owners of the company's shares.
body.detail: A private company needs at least two subscribers. Each signs the Memorandum and Articles of Association and states how many shares they take. A company subscriber, such as a parent, signs through an authorised representative named in its board resolution. Directors can also be subscribers. List every subscriber, directors included, with the shares each takes.
body.why: The subscriber list decides who owns the company on day one and is printed on the MOA, the AOA and the share certificates.
